## Runes & pouches

Items are grouped by role or matching attributes. Hover an item for its name, values and slot requirements.

Rune crafting workstation

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:crafting_altar" />
</ItemGrid>

Equipped rune storage

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:small_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:medium_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:large_rune_pouch" />
</ItemGrid>

Casting resource

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:fire_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:frost_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:healing_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:lightning_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:soul_stone" />
</ItemGrid>

Runes are ammunition, not a way to learn spells. Read the selected spell's cost before crafting a supply. Only spells with a rune cost consume them. A pouch saves carrying space but does not create runes or remove their cost.

1. Start with the rune named by your spell. For a Fire starter, combine a suitable stone base with coal using the shapeless recipe. This makes 2 Fire Runes. Use the recipe browser for other schools and alternative ingredients.
2. When you have a Rune Crafting Altar, open it and put the stone base and matching reagent into its two ingredient slots. Take the rune output. The same coal recipe makes 8 Fire Runes here, so the altar improves supply without being required for the first cast.
3. Make a Rune Pouch using the recipe below. In the inventory, hold the pouch on the cursor and right-click a rune stack to load it. Inspect the pouch contents, then place it in the supported quiver accessory slot. Casting can draw the required rune from an equipped pouch.
4. Test one affordable spell with a valid target before leaving base. If the game reports a missing rune, check the exact rune type and quantity, the pouch contents and whether the pouch is equipped. Loose runes in your inventory are also a starting option.

Lightning and Soul Runes are catalog entries, not supplies you must collect for every caster. Follow the cost of the spell you actually use. Rune-pouch recipes require Bundle API, which this selection includes.

## 符文与符文袋

这些物品栏用于识别可选物品，并非必须配齐的套装或合成配方。同组物品仅共享所列用途或属性组合，具体数值、效果与槽位要求请查看各自提示。

符文合成工作站

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:crafting_altar" />
</ItemGrid>

装备式符文储存

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:small_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:medium_rune_pouch" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:large_rune_pouch" />
</ItemGrid>

施法材料

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:fire_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:frost_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:healing_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:lightning_stone" />
  <ItemIcon id="runes:soul_stone" />
</ItemGrid>

符文是施法弹药，不会让你学会法术。先看所选法术的消耗，再制作对应符文。只有标有符文消耗的法术才会消耗符文。符文袋节省携带空间，不会生成符文，也不会免除消耗。

1. 从法术要求的符文入手。火系入门可把合适的石质基材与煤进行无序合成，得到 2 个火焰符文。其他学派与替代材料请查配方浏览器。
2. 有符文祭坛后，打开界面，把石质基材与对应材料放入两个原料槽，再取出符文。同样的煤配方在祭坛产出 8 个火焰符文。祭坛能提高补给效率，但第一次施法不需要先造祭坛。
3. 按下方配方制作符文袋。在背包中用光标拿起符文袋，右键符文堆叠以装入。查看袋内物品，再把符文袋放入支持的箭袋饰品槽。施法时可直接消耗已装备袋中的对应符文。
4. 出发前，找有效目标试放一次消耗较少的法术。若提示缺少符文，依次检查符文种类、数量、袋内物品与装备槽位。入门时也可直接把散装符文放在背包中。

闪电符文与灵魂符文属于物品目录，并非每个施法者都要收集的材料。以实际使用法术的消耗为准。符文袋配方需要 Bundle API，当前选择已包含此依赖。

<Recipe id="runes:pouch/small_rune_pouch" />

***

Better Combat gives supported weapons attack patterns and animations. Compare reach, attack speed, damage and any two-handed requirement. Bows and crossbows also differ in drawing or loading behavior.

Attack with <KeyBind id="key.attack" /> and use items with <KeyBind id="key.use" />.

***

## Rolls & spells

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:staff_arcane" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

Roll with <KeyBind id="keybinds.combat_roll.roll" />. Combat Roll supplies the dodge action and rolls in whatever direction you are moving. The roll has a short cooldown that the HUD shows, and it adds exhaustion, so repeated rolls shorten the time before you need food. A roll is unavailable while you use an item, jump or swim.

Invulnerability during a roll is off by default in this selection, so treat a roll as repositioning rather than a guaranteed dodge. Critical Strike supplies melee critical attributes, and neither a weapon animation nor a roll promises invulnerability.

Spell actions use the Spell Engine hotbar. Assign its controls in Key Binds if an action is unbound. The recipe browser uses separate settings, so a shared key can need attention in both interfaces.

## 攻击与武器类型

| 巨剑或巨锤 | <ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:iron_claymore" /><ItemIcon id="paladins:iron_great_hammer" /></ItemGrid> | 挥动更慢，需要双手持握。 |

***

Better Combat 为支持的武器提供攻击模式与动画。比较攻击距离、攻速、伤害及双手要求，弓弩还各有蓄力或装填方式。

用 <KeyBind id="key.attack" /> 攻击，用 <KeyBind id="key.use" /> 使用物品。

***

## 翻滚与施法

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:staff_arcane" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

按 <KeyBind id="keybinds.combat_roll.roll" /> 翻滚。Combat Roll 提供闪避动作，并按当前移动方向翻滚。翻滚有短暂冷却，界面会显示剩余时间，同时消耗饥饿度，连续翻滚会更快需要进食。使用物品、跳跃或游泳时无法翻滚。

本整合默认关闭翻滚期间的无敌帧，因此请把翻滚当作重新走位，而不是必定躲开攻击。Critical Strike 提供近战暴击属性，武器动画或翻滚本身都不保证无敌。

法术招式使用 Spell Engine 快捷栏。若招式没有绑定按键，可在按键设置中分配。配方浏览器使用独立设置，按键重复时可能需要同时检查两处界面。

- [法术与招式](combat.abilities.md) 查看职业书绑定与法术快捷栏要求。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="jewelry:jewelers_kit" /></ItemGrid>

Open the Curios accessory interface and place each item in its accepted slot. Jewelry modifies attributes. Relics can grant passive, triggered or activated effects, so read the activation condition and cooldown. A ring, a necklace and a relic are not interchangeable slots.

## Equipment roles

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_chestplate" /><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /></ItemGrid>

Weapons and focuses determine attack patterns and spell access. Armor supplies protection and build attributes. Accessories add attributes or item-specific effects in their accepted slots.

| Equipment | Compare |
| --- | --- |
| Weapon or focus | Attack pattern, damage, speed, reach and compatible abilities. |
| Armor | Protection, matching spell-school bonuses and set requirements. |
| Accessories | Attribute, accepted slot, trigger condition and cooldown. |

A Fire-power bonus does not strengthen a Frost spell. Compare melee damage for melee techniques, ranged damage for archery and the matching spell-power school for magic or healing. Read haste and critical modifiers too.

- [Weapons & armor](equipment.weapons-armor.md) Class equipment, named sets, Arsenal and Cataclysm.
- [Accessories](equipment.accessories.md) Starter ring recipes, jewelry and relic catalogs.
- [Armor & status](equipment.display.md) Equipment attributes and temporary effects.

***

## First equipment

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

Choose a class weapon or focus before spending rare materials on armor. A craftable copper or iron ring can add early protection, but does not unlock class spells. A triggered equipment bonus is not another freely castable class spell.

- [Combat](reference.skills.md) Class choices and starter recipes in each class article.

## 装备作用

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_sword" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:iron_chestplate" /><ItemIcon id="jewelry:copper_ring" /></ItemGrid>

武器与法器决定攻击模式及可用法术。护甲提供防护与构筑属性。饰品在适用槽位中增加属性或物品专属效果。

| 装备 | 比较内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 武器或法器 | 攻击模式、伤害、攻速、距离与兼容招式。 |
| 护甲 | 防护、对应学派加成与套装要求。 |
| 饰品 | 属性、适用槽位、触发条件与冷却。 |

火焰强度不会增强冰霜法术。近战招式比较近战伤害，弓术比较远程伤害，魔法与治疗比较对应学派的法术强度，同时查看急速与暴击属性。

## First steps

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

1. Open a class article and craft its starter weapon or focus. Weapon-provided abilities are separate from class-book abilities.
2. Create and bind the matching class book at a Spell Binding Table, then equip it in its spell-book slot with compatible held equipment. Check the displayed experience, lapis, bookshelf and casting-resource requirements.
3. Open <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> and read connected nodes and incompatible roots before spending. Class points, weapon points and ordinary experience levels are separate. Changing equipment does not refund points.

| <ItemImage id="witcher_rpg:iron_witcher_sword" /> [开始猎魔人配装](class.witcher.md) | 辅助与混合 | 使用剑术及控制、防护法印 |

猎魔人的剑术书与法印书属于同一职业的两条路线。弓箭手扩展路线可先用弓，再搭配专属护甲。

***

## 起步步骤

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

1. 打开职业文章，制作对应的入门武器或法器。武器自带招式与职业书招式不同。
2. 在法术绑定台创建并绑定对应职业书，将书装备到法术书槽，同时手持兼容装备。查看界面要求的经验、青金石、书架能量与施法材料。
3. 按 <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" />，分配前查看相连节点与互斥根节点。职业点数、武器点数与普通经验等级各自独立。更换装备不会返还点数。

- [法术与招式](combat.abilities.md) 创建职业书、绑定与施法。
- [技能成长](combat.skills.md) 职业路线、武器分支与重置。
- [装备](reference.equipment.md) 让武器、护甲与饰品契合招式属性。
- [武器与闪避](combat.handling.md) 攻击模式、翻滚与操作。
- [武技职业](combat.martial.md) 比较近战与远程职业。
- [法术与支援职业](combat.magic.md) 施法职业、武器法术与符文。

reference.food.en_us:
## Kitchen meals

Farmer’s Delight covers everyday cooking from prepared portions to shared feasts. Choose the kitchen tool and serving form before gathering ingredients.

- <ItemImage id="farmersdelight:cooking_pot" /> [Cooking tools & meals](food.utensils.md) explains cutting, heated pot meals, sandwiches, rice, pasta, feasts, desserts and drinks.

***

## Hunger & variety

- <ItemImage id="minecraft:apple" /> [Hunger, food stacks & variety](food.hunger.md) explains hunger, saturation, the rolling diet, Short Stacks limits and food storage.

***

## Farming & fishing

- <ItemImage id="minecraft:wheat" /> [Crop ingredients](food.growing.md) explains wild crop sources, seeds, rice processing and harvesting helpers.
- <ItemImage id="minecraft:cod" /> [Fishing](food.fishing.md) introduces Starcatcher rods, tackle, bait and collecting.
- <ItemImage id="minecraft:salmon" /> [Fishing habitats](fishing.habitats.md) connects fish requirements with Terralith terrain.
- <ItemImage id="oceansdelight:cooked_stuffed_squid" /> [Seafood](food.seafood.md) covers Starcatcher's Delight, Hybrid Delights, Ocean's Delight and Spawn ingredient families.

***

## Regional ingredients

- <ItemImage id="minecraft:crimson_fungus" /> [Nether foods](food.nether.md) connects Nether hunting and pepper ingredients to sausages, stews and ghast dough.
- <ItemImage id="minecraft:chorus_fruit" /> [End foods](food.end.md) distinguishes gathered chorus ingredients from knife-hunted shulker meat and dragon encounters.
- <ItemImage id="minecraft:brown_mushroom" /> [Underground foods](food.underground.md) covers cave crops, hunted ingredients, squid dishes, plant meals and copper serving containers.
- <ItemImage id="minecraft:rotten_flesh" /> [Encounter foods](food.encounters.md) covers Cataclysm creature ingredients and specialized boss dishes.

***

## Machine cooking

- <ItemImage id="minecraft:smoker" /> [Machine kitchens](food.machine-cooking.md) separates slicing, drink fluids and crop production from finished meal recipes.

***

## Mechanical Trowel

![The Mechanical Trowel palette manager](images/visual-trowel-palette.png)

The Mechanical Trowel palette manager

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />
</ItemGrid>

The <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" /> is a functional building tool, not another decorative block. Quick mode randomly places blocks from your hotbar. Named palettes let you control a repeated material mix, and gradient mode transitions between palette sections. Placement consumes available building materials.

### Acquisition

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />

Craft one trowel with one <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_ingot" />, one <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_block" /> and one <ItemLink id="minecraft:stick" /> arranged along the diagonal shown in the recipe.

### Palette controls

| Action | Your key |
| --- | --- |
| Palette manager | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_palette" /> |
| Building mode | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_build_mode" /> |
| Radial menu | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_radial_menu" /> |
| Replacement mode | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_replace" /> |

Prepare a hotbar mix for quick placement, or open the palette manager to create and select a named palette. Preview the target before using a bulk operation. Replacement changes existing blocks, so test it on a small disposable section first.

***

## Trowel upgrades

| Upgrade item | Function |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> | Unlocks wand mode, which extends blocks using the current palette. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" /> | Raises the wand operation's block limit. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" /> | Converts available base blocks to supported Chipped or Rechiseled variants. Chipped is installed here. |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" /> | Extends placement reach. |

Upgrade recipes are controlled by server settings. The shipped default requires the wand upgrade for wand mode. Applied Energistics 2 and Refined Storage integration templates require their corresponding storage mods.

### Wand template

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />

Use the smithing table with an ender pearl in the template slot, your trowel as the base and <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> as the addition. The recipe returns the upgraded trowel.

### Other upgrades

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />

These upgrades use the same smithing slot arrangement with their matching upgrade item. Check the recipe browser for whether a server enables each recipe.

## 机械抹刀

![机械抹刀配色管理界面](images/visual-trowel-palette.png)

机械抹刀配色管理界面

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />
  <ItemIcon id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" /> 是实用建筑工具，并非另一种装饰方块。快速模式随机放置快捷栏中的方块。命名配色板可控制重复使用的材质组合，渐变模式则在不同配色段之间过渡。放置会消耗实际可用的建筑材料。

### 获取

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:mech_trowel" />

按配方所示对角线摆放一个 <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_ingot" />、一个 <ItemLink id="minecraft:iron_block" /> 和一个 <ItemLink id="minecraft:stick" />，制作一把抹刀。

### 配色操作

| 操作 | 当前按键 |
| --- | --- |
| 配色管理器 | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_palette" /> |
| 建筑模式 | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_build_mode" /> |
| 轮盘菜单 | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.open_radial_menu" /> |
| 替换模式 | <KeyBind id="key.mechtrowel.toggle_replace" /> |

快速放置前在快捷栏准备材质组合，也可打开配色管理器创建并选择命名配色板。批量操作前先预览目标。替换会改变已有方块，应先在可舍弃的小区域试用。

***

## 抹刀升级

| 升级物品 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> | 解锁魔杖模式，按当前配色板扩展方块。 |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" /> | 提高单次魔杖操作的方块上限。 |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" /> | 用已有基础方块转换为支持的 Chipped 或 Rechiseled 变体。此版本已安装 Chipped。 |
| <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" /> | 增加放置距离。 |

升级配方受服务器设置控制。模组自带默认设置要求先升级才能使用魔杖模式。Applied Energistics 2 与 Refined Storage 的整合模板需要相应仓储模组。

### 魔杖模板

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_template" />

在锻造台的模板槽放入末影珍珠，以抹刀为基础物品，以 <ItemLink id="mechtrowel:wand_template" /> 为附加物品。配方返回升级后的抹刀。

### 容量、变体与距离

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:wand_capacity_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:variant_conversion_template" />

<Recipe id="mechtrowel:reach_upgrade_template" />

这些升级采用相同锻造槽位安排，换成对应升级物品。通过配方浏览器确认服务器是否开放各项配方。

***

## Ship orientation

Aeronautics Camera Sync tilts the viewpoint with a sloping ship deck. Aeronautics Player Tilt aligns the player body with the ship. Camera tilt and body tilt are separate controls. Neither steers the ship.

| Action | Your key | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Toggle camera tilt | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.toggle" /> | I |
| Toggle player tilt | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.toggle" /> | O |
| Camera settings | <KeyBind id="key.aero_cam_sync.open_config" /> | Unbound |
| Player tilt settings | <KeyBind id="key.aero_player_tilt.open_config" /> | Unbound |

Assign settings shortcuts in Options, Controls, then Key Binds. Check conflicts before using the default keys. If deck tilt makes aiming uncomfortable, adjust camera and body tilt separately in their settings.

***

## 船上姿态

Aeronautics Camera Sync 让视角随倾斜甲板转动，Aeronautics Player Tilt 让玩家身体朝向与船体对齐。镜头倾斜与身体倾斜分别控制，都不会操纵船体转向。

## Unified fuels

![Create fluid tanks beside a Nether portal](images/feedback-nether-tanks.png)

Create fluid tanks beside a Nether portal

![Fluid supply to a Blaze Burner](images/feedback-liquid-fuel.png)

Fluid supply to a Blaze Burner

Create: Unified Fuels connects supported fuel consumers through shared fuel groups and generated compatibility data. It adds no separate machine or item catalog. The selected release covers systems such as The Factory Must Grow, Crafts & Additions burners, Liquid Fuel and Stuff 'N Additions fueling tanks when the corresponding addon is present.

Fuel acceptance still depends on the consumer, fluid group and actual recipe. Refinery intermediates, process chemicals and steam are not automatically burnable fuel. Do not assume any fluid can power every engine or superheat every burner. Check the recipe browser before connecting a shared fuel supply.

- [Materials & fuels](power.industry.md)

***

  <ItemIcon id="create:fluid_tank" />

  <ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />
</ItemGrid>

| Items & families | Use |

| <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> | Create Blaze Burner supplies heat. Create: Liquid Fuel extends this existing burner rather than adding a separate machine. |
| <ItemLink id="create:fluid_tank" />, <ItemLink id="create:fluid_pipe" />, <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_pump" /> | Tank, pipe and pump components provide fluid supply. |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> | The released liquid-fuel definition accepts lava for ordinary heat, not superheating. The bucket icon represents the fluid. |

***

## Getting started

### Empty burner

<Recipe id="create:crafting/kinetics/empty_blaze_burner" />

Craft <ItemLink id="create:empty_blaze_burner" /> first. It is not a captured <ItemLink id="create:blaze_burner" /> yet. Capture a blaze using the empty burner before supplying fuel.

Start with a captured Blaze Burner and inspect the lava supply route. Do not assume diesel, gasoline or every oil is accepted. Unified Fuels can add compatibility entries, but each consumer still has its own accepted fluids. Confirm the actual fluid in the item browser before plumbing a fuel line. Burner arrangement and heat states are covered by Create Ponder.

## 统一燃料

![烈焰燃烧室的流体供给](images/feedback-liquid-fuel.png)

Create: Unified Fuels 通过共享燃料分类与生成的兼容数据连接受支持的燃料设备，不增加独立机器或物品目录。对应扩展存在时，所选版本涵盖 The Factory Must Grow、Crafts & Additions 燃烧室、Liquid Fuel 与 Stuff 'N Additions 燃料箱等系统。

设备能否使用燃料仍取决于设备、流体分类与实际配方。炼油中间产物、工艺化学品与蒸汽不会自动变成可燃燃料。不要假定任意流体都能驱动所有引擎或让所有燃烧室超级加热。连接共用燃料供应前，请检查配方浏览器。

从捕获烈焰人的燃烧室开始，并检查熔岩供给线路。不要假定柴油、汽油或所有油类都能使用。Unified Fuels 可以增加兼容条目，但每种设备仍有各自接受的流体。接燃料管线前，请在物品浏览器确认实际流体。燃烧室布局与加热状态请看 Create 思索演示。

performance.baseline.en_us:
## Rendering

These components reduce rendering work in different parts of the client. They are not additional visual effects.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sodium | Replaces the terrain rendering engine. |
| ImmediatelyFast | Optimizes immediate-mode rendering. |
| Entity Culling | Avoids rendering hidden entities and block entities. |
| More Culling | Skips selected hidden rendering faces. |
| Cull Leaves | Skips selected hidden leaf geometry. |
| Flerovium | Optimizes item, particle and entity rendering. |
| AsyncParticles | Particle processing and rendering optimization. |
| Kerria | Accelerates animated texture processing. |
| CreateBetterFps | Create rendering optimization for shader use. |

***

## Simulation & terrain

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine spreads chunk work across processor threads. Fast Noise optimizes the noise calculations used in terrain generation. Both work in the background without special launch arguments or graphics acceleration. They do not increase render distance or regenerate explored terrain.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Lithium | Optimizes game logic in single-player and servers. |

performance.baseline.zh_cn:

| More Culling | 跳过部分不可见的渲染面。 |

| AsyncParticles | 优化粒子运算与渲染。 |
| Kerria | 加速动态纹理处理。 |
| CreateBetterFps | 优化使用光影时的机械动力渲染。 |

***

## 模拟与地形

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine 将区块工作分配给多个处理器线程，Fast Noise 优化地形生成使用的噪声计算。两者在后台工作，无需特殊启动参数或图形加速，也不会增加渲染距离或重新生成已探索地形。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Lithium | 优化单人游戏与服务器的游戏逻辑。 |
| AI Improvements: Performance Tuning | 优化原版生物行为处理。 |
| Clumps | 合并经验球，减少独立经验球的处理。 |
| Let Me Despawn | 调整生物消失规则，减少意外永久保留的生物。 |
| Create: LazyTick | 优化机械动力机器的刻处理。 |
| Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (NeoForge) | 优化区块管理与生成。 |
| Fast Noise | 优化处理器端的地形噪声计算。 |
| Structure Layout Optimizer | 优化拼图结构布局处理。 |

## 内存与加载

| ModernFix | 提供性能、内存与错误修复改进。 |

| BadOptimizations | 优化主地形渲染器以外的处理。 |

***

## 输入与空闲

输入处理与后台资源使用不同于活动世界模拟。性能优化支持不代表已经测得你的电脑能提升多少帧率。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Ixeris | 提供缓冲原始输入与独立线程事件轮询。 |
| Dynamic FPS | 降低后台或空闲时的资源使用。 |

***

## 共用优化模组

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Async Logger | 异步处理日志。 |
| Jasione | 减少重复的枚举数组分配。 |
| ServerCore | 优化服务器处理，包括单人游戏的内置服务器。 |

***

server.tools.en_us:
## Dimension borders

DimWorldBorder gives each dimension its own border size and center, including the integrated server in single-player. Multiplayer players follow the server border without needing the mod on their client.

Operators can check a border before changing it.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld get</Color> | Read the Overworld border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:the_nether get</Color> | Read the Nether border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder rocketnautics:moon get</Color> | Read the Moon border |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld set 5000</Color> | Set the Overworld square to a full width of 5000 blocks |

Use command completion to select a dimension. The packaged safety data pack also applies an Overworld limit when it loads. Check border values after a restart or data-pack reload before relying on a custom size. A player boundary does not guarantee that it contains an entire moving ship.

***

## Terrain preparation

Chunky generates terrain before players explore it. This is an administrator workload, not a rendering-distance setting. Large generation jobs consume processing time and disk space.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Chunky | Generates terrain ahead of exploration. |

***

## Diagnostics

Observable and spark identify processing costs. Client rendering and server simulation are different workloads. A server recording does not measure shader rendering cost. Access can depend on server permissions.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Observable | Identifies expensive server processing. |
| spark | Profiles client and server performance. |

***

## Pack defaults

Configured Defaults provides initial files when they are missing. Existing player choices are not the same as the packaged defaults. It is a pack-maintenance utility, not a performance profiler.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Configured Defaults | Supplies packaged defaults for missing files. |

***

## Related topics

- [Optimization](performance.baseline.md)
server.tools.zh_cn:
## 维度边界

DimWorldBorder 让各维度拥有独立的边界大小与中心，单人游戏的内置服务器也适用。多人游戏中，玩家遵循服务器边界，客户端无需安装此模组。

管理员应先查询边界，再修改设置。

| 命令 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld get</Color> | 查询主世界边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:the_nether get</Color> | 查询下界边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder rocketnautics:moon get</Color> | 查询月球边界 |
| <Color color="#F28CBD">/dimworldborder minecraft:overworld set 5000</Color> | 将主世界方形边界的完整宽度设为 5000 格 |

使用命令补全选择维度。整合包的安全数据包也会在加载时设置主世界范围限制。自定义大小后，应在重启或重载数据包后查询边界值。玩家边界不保证能容纳或阻挡整艘移动船体。

***

## 地形准备

Chunky 在玩家探索前生成地形。这是管理员任务，不是渲染距离设置。大型生成任务会占用处理时间与磁盘空间。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Chunky | 在探索前预先生成地形。 |

***

## 诊断工具

Observable 与 spark 用于定位处理开销。客户端渲染与服务器模拟是不同工作负载。服务器记录不能衡量光影渲染开销，使用权限可能由服务器决定。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Observable | 用于定位服务器耗时处理。 |
| spark | 分析客户端与服务器性能。 |

***

## 整合包默认设置

Configured Defaults 在文件缺失时提供初始文件。已有玩家设置与整合包默认值并不相同。它是整合包维护工具，不是性能分析器。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Configured Defaults | 为缺失文件提供整合包默认设置。 |

***

## 相关页面

- [性能优化](performance.baseline.md)

## Equipment on ships

The Create Stuff 'N Additions Sable and Aeronautics compatibility addon adapts that equipment to moving ships. It is a compatibility layer, not a new vehicle family. Use the equipment's own recipes and controls, and do not assume it makes every interaction on a moving build interchangeable with a stationary one.

***

## Moving structures

Sable: Physics Compat supplies block physics properties. Sable Beyond extends moving-structure behavior. Neither is a catalogue of craftable vehicles. Compatibility support does not mean every block interaction works on a moving build.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sable: Physics Compat | Adds physics property tags to supported modded blocks. |
| Sable Beyond | Extends moving-structure behavior and compatibility. |

***

## Automatic fixes

AttributeFix repairs attribute limits. Neo Bee Fix repairs bee behavior. These run as supporting fixes rather than administrator tools or crafting systems.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| AttributeFix | Removes arbitrary attribute limits for mod compatibility. |
| Neo Bee Fix | Repairs vanilla bee behavior. |

***

## Feature bridges

Sound and animation bridges are listed with the feature they change. Shared frameworks remain in Libraries.

## Rain & footsteps

Cool Rain Reforged changes rain ambience on supported surfaces. Presence Footsteps changes footsteps according to the surface walked on. Their Sable addons belong here because they extend those sounds to moving structures.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Cool Rain Reforged | Adds rain sounds for particular block surfaces. |
| Presence Footsteps (NeoForge) | Adds surface-sensitive footstep sounds. |
| Sable: Cool Rain | Extends rain sounds to Sable moving structures and supported copycat materials. |
| Presence Footsteps x Sable (Aeronautics Compat) | Extends Presence Footsteps to Sable moving structures. |

***

## Sound effects

Sounds adds interaction and interface sounds. More Sounds extends its content and mod compatibility. These do not replace the footstep and rain compatibility roles above.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sounds | Adds sounds for interfaces, items, blocks and other interactions. |
| More Sounds | Adds sound content and mod compatibility to Sounds. |

***

## Acoustics & volume

Sound Physics Remastered changes how sound travels through the surroundings. Extreme sound muffler quiets selected sounds on your client. Muting a machine sound does not stop the machine or change its processing.

| Component | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sound Physics Remastered | Adds sound attenuation, reverberation and absorption through blocks. |
| Extreme sound muffler | Lets the client selectively quiet unwanted sounds. |

***

## Related topics

- [Moving structures](vehicles.assembly.md)

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Cool Rain Reforged | 为特定方块表面增加雨声。 |
| Presence Footsteps (NeoForge) | 增加随踩踏表面变化的脚步声。 |
| Sable: Cool Rain | 将雨声扩展到 Sable 移动结构与受支持的伪装材质。 |
| Presence Footsteps x Sable (Aeronautics Compat) | 让 Presence Footsteps 适配 Sable 移动结构。 |

***

## 交互音效

Sounds 增加交互与界面音效，More Sounds 扩展其内容和模组兼容。它们与上方脚步声及雨声兼容组件的作用不同。

| 内容 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| Sounds | 为界面、物品、方块及其他交互增加音效。 |
| More Sounds | 为 Sounds 增加声音内容与模组兼容。 |

***

## 声学与音量

Sound Physics Remastered 改变声音在环境中的传播方式。Extreme sound muffler 在客户端降低选定声音。静音机器不会停止机器，也不会改变其处理过程。

space.vehicle-transfer.en_us:
## Rocket propulsion

![Spacecraft above Earth](images/feedback-earth-orbit.png)

Spacecraft above Earth

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />
  <ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_crafter" />
  <ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />
</ItemGrid>

| Equipment | Use |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /> | Liquid-fuel propulsion for an assembled physical ship. |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_crafter" /> | Crafts the thruster. Find its mechanical crafting layout in the recipe browser. |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> | Represents Lava fuel. Supply the fluid through the ship's fluid system, rather than inserting a bucket as a crafting ingredient. |

The thruster burns rocket fuel, not rotational power. Lava is a supported starting fuel. Its Ponder scene shows the engine and tank arrangement.

***

## Leaving the Overworld

Assemble a physical spacecraft with Sable, fit the thruster and keep its fuel supply running. Crossing above world Y 20,000 transfers the ship and nearby passengers into Deep Space. This height is a world coordinate, not a distance above the launch pad.

Deep Space is the orbital route to planetary surfaces. A change in sky appearance alone does not indicate a dimension transition.

***

## Surface entry

Approach the current linked planet in Deep Space. Crossing inward to within 20,000 blocks of its surface transfers the ship into that planet's dimension at world Y 19,000. The Overworld and Moon use these boundaries. Surface entry leaves the ship high above the terrain, not landed or under automatic control.

Slow descent before world Y 2,500. Between Y 1,000 and Y 2,500, downward speeds above 60 blocks per second cause heating. Stronger heating can damage nearby passengers.

***

## 火箭推进

![地球上空的飞船](images/feedback-earth-orbit.png)

地球上空的飞船

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" />
  <ItemIcon id="create:mechanical_crafter" />
  <ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />
</ItemGrid>

| 装备 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:rocket_thruster" /> | 为已组装的物理飞船提供液体燃料推力。 |
| <ItemLink id="create:mechanical_crafter" /> | 制作推进器。在配方浏览器中查看机械合成的排列。 |
| <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> | 图示代表熔岩燃料。通过飞船的流体系统供给熔岩，不是将桶作为合成材料放入推进器。 |

推进器消耗火箭燃料，不使用旋转动力。熔岩是一种可用的入门燃料。推进器的 Ponder 演示展示推进器与储罐的布置。

***

## 离开主世界

用 Sable 组装物理飞船，安装推进器并保持燃料供应。飞船越过世界坐标 Y 20,000 后，会与附近乘客一起进入深空。此高度是世界坐标，不是距离发射台的高度。

深空是前往行星地表的轨道空间。仅凭天空画面变化，不能判断是否已进入其他维度。

***

## 进入地表维度

在深空中接近当前所环绕且有地表维度的行星。进入距其表面 20,000 格以内的范围后，飞船会转入该行星的维度，位于世界坐标 Y 19,000。主世界与月球都使用这些边界。进入地表维度后，飞船仍在高空，不会自动着陆或自动驾驶。

请在世界坐标 Y 2,500 之前减慢下降速度。在 Y 1,000 至 Y 2,500 之间，以超过每秒 60 格的速度下降会使飞船发热。更强的热量可能伤害附近乘客。

***

A corpse holding dropped equipment

Corpse leaves a body at your death location containing your carried items. Return to that location and interact with the body to open its inventory. Recovering items still requires reaching the site safely, prepare replacement equipment before returning to a dangerous encounter.

Corpse x Curios compatibility restores supported accessories to their equipment slots when transferring them. Check your slots after recovery rather than assuming every accessory is equipped.

***

## Death history

The death-history interface records earlier deaths. Find its binding in Controls if another action uses the same key. History is a reference for recovery, it does not grant free survival-mode item retrieval or teleportation. Administrative and creative recovery features have separate permissions.

Access restrictions and corpse expiry can depend on server settings. Do not treat a body as permanent storage.

***

## Related topics

- [Maps](maps.personal.md) Navigation and waypoints.
- [Accessories](equipment.accessories.md) Equipment slots.

## 取回装备

![保存掉落装备的遗体](images/visual-corpse-recovery.png)

保存掉落装备的遗体

Corpse 会在死亡地点留下尸体，保存携带的物品。返回该地点并与尸体交互，即可打开其物品界面。取回物品仍然需要安全抵达现场，重返危险战斗区域前应先准备替代装备。

Corpse 的 Curios 联动可在转移物品时，把支持的饰品放回对应装备栏。取回后仍应检查栏位，不要假定所有饰品都已装备。

***

## 死亡记录

死亡记录界面保存先前死亡的信息。如果按键与其他操作冲突，可在控制设置中查找对应绑定。记录用于辅助取回物品，不会免费提供生存模式物品恢复或传送。管理和创造模式的恢复功能具有独立权限要求。

尸体访问限制和消失时间可能由服务器设置决定，不要将尸体当作永久仓库。

***

## Hammocks & time

Hammocks provide daytime rest that turns day into night, without changing your respawn point. The pack allows hammocks during the day and sleeping bags at night, server settings can change those rules.

Better Days controls day and night duration and can accelerate time while players sleep. The server determines its active time settings, installing the mod does not imply a particular day length or that every processing machine accelerates with sleep.

combat.abilities.en_us:
## Prepare a class book

![Spell books and the Spell Binding Table](images/visual-spell-binding.png)

<EmiSearch query="@spell_engine" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

A weapon's built-in ability is separate from the spells a class book teaches.

1. Put a normal <ItemLink id="minecraft:book" /> in the table, select the matching class book and pay the displayed experience levels. Witcher offers separate Fencing and Signs books.
2. Put the class book back with <ItemLink id="minecraft:lapis_lazuli" /> and pick abilities that meet the shown level, lapis cost and bookshelf power. Add valid nearby <ItemLink id="minecraft:bookshelf" /> when power is short, and watch for tier conflicts or the book's slot limit.
3. Equip the configured book in its spell-book slot and hold a compatible weapon or focus. The held item filters which spells you can use.

Class books are configured versions of <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_book" />, not separate craftable items. A <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /> carries one spell, so read the next section before spending it.

***

## Use a spell scroll

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

A scroll uses a single spell found as loot or adds it to a compatible book, and it is not a universal unlock for every class.

- To try its spell alone, equip the scroll in the supported spell-book slot instead of your book and hold a compatible weapon. A separate scroll slot only works if it is enabled, so do not assume every accessory slot accepts one.
- To keep the spell, put the receiving class book in the table's book slot and the scroll in the material slot instead of lapis. Select the offered spell and confirm that the book's pool accepts it before applying.
- If no offer appears, check that the spell belongs to that pool, then inspect existing spells, tier conflicts and remaining capacity. More ordinary experience cannot fix an incompatible book.

Applying the offered spell consumes the scroll and charges the displayed experience-level cost. This transfer does not require lapis. Use the table's current offer rather than assuming scroll binding costs the same as learning with lapis.

***

## Cast an ability

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

Read its tooltip for school, target, casting time, resource cost and cooldown, and keep required ammunition or runes ready. A learned spell can stay unavailable with an incompatible weapon, and the casting bar shows a cast still in progress.

The first spell action is set in Key Binds, currently <KeyBind id="keybindings.spell_engine.spell_hotbar_1" />, and you can change it there when it shows as unbound.

- [Magic & support](combat.magic.md) Weapon spells, songs, rune types and pouch crafting.
- [Combat controls](combat.handling.md) Attacks, rolls and control conflicts.

***

## Gear & skill points

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="skill_tree_rpgs:orb_of_oblivion" /></ItemGrid>

Match the ability's attribute to your equipment. Fire power strengthens Fire spells and not Frost spells, and healing uses healing power. Melee and ranged techniques can use different attributes even within one class. Armor protection and school bonuses do different jobs, and relic triggers are not freely castable class spells.

Binding spends ordinary experience levels. Class points and weapon points develop their own connected trees and do not replace binding, and changing equipment does not refund points.

- [Character skills](combat.skills.md) Open with <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" />, read incompatible roots and check resets.
- [Weapons & armor](equipment.weapons-armor.md) Class equipment and shared named sets.
- [Accessories](equipment.accessories.md) Jewelry, relics and accepted slots.

***

## Starter focuses

The Novice Wand is a low-cost Fire starting point, not an Arcane or Frost substitute. The Acolyte Wand starts healing with sticks and string. Other starters and complete ability inventories belong to their class articles.

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<Recipe id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

<Recipe id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

- [Martial classes](combat.martial.md) Ranged and melee class articles.
- [Magic & support classes](combat.magic.md) Magic and support class articles.

***

## When an ability does not work

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" /></ItemGrid>

| Symptom | Check first |
| --- | --- |
| Spell missing from the hotbar | Is the book equipped, does it hold the spell, and does the held weapon allow it? |
| Action shows but will not cast | Runes or ammunition, cooldown, target and range, then the key binding. |
| Damage or healing feels low | The ability's attribute against the held weapon and armor. A higher armor value is not spell power. |

Change one thing, then repeat a low-risk cast. A working setup shows the intended ability and produces its described attack, healing or protection effect.

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+spell+binding+table+spell+book+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+%E6%B3%95%E6%9C%AF%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%B0+%E8%81%8C%E4%B8%9A%E4%B9%A6+%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)
combat.abilities.zh_cn:
## 准备职业书

![法术书与法术绑定台](images/visual-spell-binding.png)

<EmiSearch query="@spell_engine" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_binding" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_binding" />

<Recipe id="spell_engine:spell_binding_table" />

武器自带招式与职业书教授的招式是两回事。

1. 将普通 <ItemLink id="minecraft:book" /> 放入绑定台，选择对应职业书并支付显示的经验等级。猎魔人有独立的剑术书与法印书。
2. 将职业书放回绑定台并放入 <ItemLink id="minecraft:lapis_lazuli" />，选择满足等级、青金石消耗与书架能量的招式。能量不足时在附近添加有效的 <ItemLink id="minecraft:bookshelf" />，并留意同阶冲突与书籍槽位上限。
3. 将配置好的书放入法术书槽，并手持兼容武器或法器。手持物品会筛选可用法术。

职业书是 <ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_book" /> 的配置变体，并非独立的合成物品。<ItemLink id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /> 只携带一个法术，使用前先看下一节。

***

## 使用法术卷轴

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_scroll" /><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /></ItemGrid>

卷轴可让你使用战利品中的单个法术，或把它加入兼容书籍，但它不能通用于所有职业。

- 想单独试用时，把卷轴放入支持的法术书槽暂时代替职业书，再手持兼容武器。独立卷轴槽只有启用后才能使用，并非所有饰品槽都接受卷轴。
- 想保存在书中，把接收法术的职业书放入绑定台的书籍槽，用卷轴代替青金石放入材料槽。选择显示的法术，并确认书籍池接受该法术后再应用。
- 若没有可用选项，先确认该法术属于这本书的法术池，再检查已学招式、同阶冲突与剩余容量。书籍不兼容时，积攒更多普通经验也不能解决。

应用所选法术会消耗卷轴，并扣除界面显示的普通经验等级。这种转移不需要青金石。以绑定台当前显示为准，不要假设卷轴绑定与青金石学习消耗相同。

***

## 释放招式

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="minecraft:book" /></ItemGrid>

查看提示中的学派、目标、施法时间、材料消耗与冷却，并备好所需弹药或符文。已学法术仍可能因武器不兼容而无法使用，施法条显示施法是否仍在进行。

第一个招式在按键设置中配置，当前为 <KeyBind id="keybindings.spell_engine.spell_hotbar_1" />，显示未绑定时可在那里修改。

- [魔法与辅助](combat.magic.md) 武器法术、乐曲、符文种类与符文袋制作。
- [战斗操作](combat.handling.md) 攻击、翻滚与按键冲突。

***

## 装备与技能点

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="skill_tree_rpgs:orb_of_oblivion" /></ItemGrid>

让装备契合招式使用的属性。火焰强度增强火系法术，不增强冰霜法术，治疗则使用治疗强度。同一职业的近战与远程招式也可能使用不同属性。护甲防护与学派加成作用不同，遗物触发效果也不是可任意释放的职业法术。

绑定消耗普通经验等级。职业点数与武器点数用于各自相连的技能树，不能代替绑定，更换装备也不会返还点数。

- [技能成长](combat.skills.md) 按 <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> 打开界面，查看互斥根节点与重置。
- [武器与护甲](equipment.weapons-armor.md) 职业装备与通用具名套装。
- [饰品](equipment.accessories.md) 珠宝、遗物与适用槽位。

***

## 入门法器

新手魔杖是低成本火系起点，不能代替奥术或冰霜法器。侍僧魔杖以木棍与线开始治疗路线。其他入门装备与完整招式目录见各职业文章。

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="wizards:wand_novice" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<Recipe id="wizards:wand_novice" />

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="paladins:acolyte_wand" /></ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

<Recipe id="paladins:acolyte_wand" />

- [武技职业](combat.martial.md) 远程与近战职业文章。
- [法术与支援职业](combat.magic.md) 魔法与辅助职业文章。

***

## 招式无效时

<ItemGrid><ItemIcon id="spell_engine:spell_book" /><ItemIcon id="runes:arcane_stone" /></ItemGrid>

| 现象 | 优先检查 |
| --- | --- |
| 法术没有出现在快捷栏 | 是否装备了配置好的书，书中是否已有该法术，手持武器是否允许使用？ |
| 招式出现却不能释放 | 先检查符文或弹药、冷却、有效目标与距离，再看当前按键。 |
| 开始施法却没有命中 | 蓄力或引导时间、目标条件与视线。 |
| 伤害或治疗效果偏低 | 核对该招式的属性，再比较手持武器与护甲。护甲值更高不代表法术强度更高。 |

每次只调整一项，再安全试放。能看到预期招式，并产生说明中的攻击、治疗或防护效果，才算配置成功。

![YouTube](images/tutorial-video.png) [English](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+spell+binding+table+spell+book+tutorial) · [中文](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=Minecraft+1.21.1+Spell+Engine+RPG+Series+%E6%B3%95%E6%9C%AF%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A%E5%8F%B0+%E8%81%8C%E4%B8%9A%E4%B9%A6+%E7%BB%91%E5%AE%9A+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B)

| <ItemLink id="create:copper_backtank" />, <ItemLink id="create:netherite_backtank" /> | Stored air for breathing. Charge the backtank before wearing it in the chest slot. Use its Ponder entry for charging. |

| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:jetpack" /> | Fuel-powered chestplate that supplies pressurized air and personal flight. |

Start with a Copper Diving Helmet and charged Copper Backtank. A fueled Jetpack is an alternative air source, rather than a required replacement for the backtank.

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_diving_helmet" />

<Recipe id="create:crafting/appliances/copper_backtank" />

## Jetpack fuel & flight

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />
  <ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />
  <ItemIcon id="create:spout" />
</ItemGrid>

Refill the Jetpack with Lava using <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> or a <ItemLink id="create:spout" />. Toggle flight with <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" />, whose default is G. Disable flight when you do not need it to conserve fuel. The Jetpack's air supply continues to consume fuel independently of that flight switch.

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

***

## Oxygenated rooms

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />
</ItemGrid>

Build an intact sealed compartment inside a Sable ship using Deep Seas compartment tools. Deep Air restores breathing inside an oxygenated compartment while the ship remains unbreached. It does not seal the hull or produce oxygen.

| Machine | Requirements |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | Water and Forge Energy to produce oxygen. |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | Oxygen in its tank and a redstone signal, inside the sealed room. |

Connect the oxygen supply to the diffuser and keep it running. Their Ponder entries explain power, fluid supply and redstone.

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

***

## Room gravity

![Gravity equipment in a ship compartment](images/cosmo-gravity-room.png)

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /> provides local gravity inside an intact sealed compartment. Supply Forge Energy and a neighboring redstone signal. The generator must be in an assembled Sable ship.

Gravity and breathing are separate room functions. The gravity room itself does not need a diffuser, but keep at least one room on the ship oxygenated to retain Deep Seas compartment tracking. The generator does not change the ship's orbital gravity.

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

## 喷气背包燃料与飞行

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:jetpack" />
  <ItemIcon id="minecraft:lava_bucket" />
  <ItemIcon id="create:spout" />
</ItemGrid>

用 <ItemLink id="minecraft:lava_bucket" /> 或 <ItemLink id="create:spout" /> 补充熔岩。使用 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_jetpack" /> 切换飞行，默认按键为 G。不需要飞行时关闭该功能可节省燃料。喷气背包的供气仍会消耗燃料，不受飞行开关控制。

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/jetpack" />

***

## 供氧舱室

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />
  <ItemIcon id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" />
</ItemGrid>

使用 Deep Seas 舱室工具，在 Sable 飞船内建造完好的密封舱室。飞船未破损时，Deep Air 让供氧舱室中的实体恢复呼吸。它不会密封船体，也不会制造氧气。

| 机器 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" /> | 用水与 Forge Energy 产生氧气。 |
| <ItemLink id="create_submarine:oxygene_diffuser" /> | 位于密封舱室内，储罐有氧气，并接收红石信号。 |

将氧气供给连接到扩散器，并持续供氧。两种机器的 Ponder 演示说明供能、流体与红石要求。

<Recipe id="create_submarine:electrolyzer" />

<Recipe id="create_submarine:oxygen_diffuser" />

***

## 舱室重力

![飞船舱室中的重力设备](images/cosmo-gravity-room.png)

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />
</ItemGrid>

<ItemLink id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" /> 在完好密封的舱室内提供局部重力。它需要 Forge Energy 与相邻红石信号，并且必须位于已组装的 Sable 飞船内。

重力与呼吸是不同的舱室功能。重力舱室本身不需要扩散器，但飞船至少应有一个供氧舱室，以维持 Deep Seas 的舱室追踪。发生器不会改变飞船的轨道重力。

<Recipe id="cosmonauticsdeepair:gravity_generator" />

***

## 个人移动装备

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" />
  <ItemIcon id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" />
</ItemGrid>

| 装备 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_leg_thrusters" /> | 消耗加压空气来提供飞行与惯性阻尼。使用 <KeyBind id="key.rocketnautics.toggle_dampeners" /> 切换阻尼，默认按键为 Z。 |
| <ItemLink id="rocketnautics:copper_anchor_boots" /> | 靠近支撑地板时帮助保持落地，但不影响正在飞行的玩家，也不产生舱室重力。 |

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_leg_thrusters" />

<Recipe id="rocketnautics:crafting/equipment/copper_anchor_boots" />

fishing.habitats.en_us:
## Habitat families

![Species entries and catch requirements](images/visual-fishing-guide.png)

Species entries and catch requirements

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />
  <ItemIcon id="starcatcher:fish_radar" />
</ItemGrid>

Use Starcatcher's Guide for a fish's full conditions. The habitat families below describe where to begin looking, not a guarantee that every pool contains every listed catch.

| Habitat | Examples & terrain |
| --- | --- |
| Cold freshwater | Frostjaw Trout and Wintery Pike. Cold and frozen Terralith terrain includes Birch Taiga, Windswept Spires and winter islands. |
| Warm freshwater | Sandtail, Scorchfish, Mirage Carp, Agave Bream, Cactifish and Oasis Sturgeon. Arid, desert, badlands and savanna terrain includes Granite Cliffs. Snowy Badlands is excluded from these warm catches. |
| Cherry landscapes | Blossomfish and Pink Koi. Sakura Grove, Sakura Valley, Snowy Cherry Grove and Spring Skylands share cherry habitat catches. |
| Flowering landscapes | Petal Bass. Flower-rich valleys, spring skylands and Terralith's flower-forest group, including Cloud Forest and the Moonlight landscapes. |
| Open grassland | Sunflower Carp. Prairie and open grassland equivalents. |
| Dark forest | Enchanted forest catches also extend into Moonlight groves. |
| Ice formations | Aurora and other ice-spike catches. Frozen cliffs, Glacial Chasm and Emerald Peaks. |
| Lush caves | Lush Pike, Mossfin and Shadowfin. Fungal caves and Underground Jungle join this habitat. |
| Geological caves | Dripfin and Fossilized Angelfish. Stone and thermal caves join the dripstone selection. |
| Deep dark | Sculkfish, Ward and Glowing Dark. Frostfire Caves also has matching sculk terrain. |
| Oceans | Ocean, deep-ocean and warm-ocean selections include Terralith's Deep Warm Ocean. The Hybrid Aquatic bridge keeps its own ocean fish conditions. |

***

## Terralith fishing

The pack connects all 95 Terralith biomes to suitable water-fishing selections at surface or underground elevations. Some retain general freshwater, forest, jungle or taiga fish rather than a unique species set. A biome can qualify without having naturally generated water at the exact position you visit.

Frostfire Caves shares both sculk and dripstone catches. Ordinary deep, infested and mantle caves retain underground freshwater selections. Sparse bamboo does not count as dense Bamboo Jungle, and the Nether and End keep their original dimension restrictions.

***

## Reading catch conditions

| Condition | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| Biome | Hover multiple habitat selectors in the Guide. A broad habitat tag can include more than the original vanilla biome. |
| Height & light | Surface, cave and mountain catches can differ within the same biome. Check the fishing position's elevation and light. |
| Time & weather | Day, night, rain and thunder restrictions still apply after choosing a suitable biome. |
| Fluid & dimension | Water, lava and other catch media are distinct. Overworld water does not replace Nether lava. |
| Bait | Distinguish a preference from a required bait. |

The habitat integration changes rod-catch eligibility. It does not broaden natural animal-spawning tags or increase wildlife density. Catch rarity, difficulty and other conditions remain those of the individual fish.

***

## 栖息地类型

![鱼种条目与垂钓条件](images/visual-fishing-guide.png)

鱼种条目与垂钓条件

<ItemGrid>
  <ItemIcon id="starcatcher:starcatcher_guide" />
  <ItemIcon id="starcatcher:fish_radar" />
</ItemGrid>

使用 Starcatcher 图鉴查看鱼种的完整条件。下表说明从哪里开始寻找，并不保证每个水池都有全部所列渔获。

| 栖息地 | 渔获与地形示例 |
| --- | --- |
| 寒冷淡水 | Frostjaw Trout 与 Wintery Pike。寒冷和冰冻的 Terralith 地形包括 Birch Taiga、Windswept Spires 与冬季岛屿。 |
| 温暖淡水 | Sandtail、Scorchfish、Mirage Carp、Agave Bream、Cactifish 与 Oasis Sturgeon。干旱、沙漠、恶地和热带草原地形包括 Granite Cliffs。Snowy Badlands 不提供这些温暖渔获。 |
| 樱花地形 | Blossomfish 与 Pink Koi。Sakura Grove、Sakura Valley、Snowy Cherry Grove 与 Spring Skylands 共用樱花栖息地渔获。 |
| 繁花地形 | Petal Bass。花卉山谷、春季空岛与 Terralith 繁花森林分类，包括 Cloud Forest 与 Moonlight 地形。 |
| 开阔草地 | Sunflower Carp。草原及类似的开阔草地。 |
| 黑森林 | 魔法森林渔获也扩展到 Moonlight 林地。 |
| 冰雪地形 | Aurora 与其他冰刺渔获。冰冻峭壁、Glacial Chasm 与 Emerald Peaks。 |
| 繁茂洞穴 | Lush Pike、Mossfin 与 Shadowfin。真菌洞穴与 Underground Jungle 也属于此栖息地。 |
| 岩石洞穴 | Dripfin 与 Fossilized Angelfish。石质洞穴与地热洞穴共用滴水石渔获。 |
| 深暗之域 | Sculkfish、Ward 与 Glowing Dark。Frostfire Caves 也有匹配的幽匿地形。 |
| 海洋 | 海洋、深海与暖水海洋渔获包括 Terralith 的 Deep Warm Ocean。Hybrid Aquatic 兼容组件保留各海鱼自己的条件。 |

***

## Terralith 钓鱼

整合包为全部九十五种 Terralith 生物群系接入适合的地表或地下水域渔获。部分地形保留一般淡水、森林、丛林或针叶林鱼类，并非每种地形都有独有鱼种。生物群系符合条件，也不保证你所在的具体位置天然有水。

Frostfire Caves 同时提供幽匿与滴水石渔获。普通深层、虫蚀和地幔洞穴保留地下淡水渔获。稀疏竹子不等同于密集竹林，下界与末地也保留原有维度限制。

***

## 查看垂钓条件

| 条件 | 检查内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 生物群系 | 在图鉴中悬停查看多个栖息地选项。范围较广的栖息地标签可包含原版群系以外的地形。 |
| 高度与光照 | 同一生物群系内，地表、洞穴与高山渔获可能不同。检查钓点的高度与光照。 |
| 时间与天气 | 选择合适生物群系后，白天、夜晚、雨天与雷暴限制仍然适用。 |
| 流体与维度 | 水、熔岩与其他垂钓介质不同。主世界水域不能代替下界熔岩。 |
| 鱼饵 | 区分偏好的鱼饵与必需的鱼饵。 |

栖息地整合改变钓鱼竿的渔获资格，不扩展自然动物生成标签，也不增加野生生物密度。渔获稀有度、小游戏难度与其他条件仍取决于各鱼种。

***

Great White Sharks also have shipwreck encounter definitions. A beached shipwreck is not evidence that a shark can survive on dry land. Not every named entity is ordinary wildlife. Goldfish, Hagfish, Nautilus, Pearlfish, Umbrella Octopus, Vampire Squid, Beakling, Shell Beast, Karcinogen, Karcinoma and Karkinos have no ordinary biome-spawn entry in this catalog.
